ModMetadata.Name: Mirror
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Mirror[/h1] [i]Build any structure the other way around.[/i]
[b]🚧 Work in progress.[/b] Expect rough edges; please report problems through the source link at the bottom.
Pumps, regulators, filtration units, docks and almost every other structure can be placed mirrored: no new kits, no new prefabs. A mirrored structure is the same item as the normal one, so your IC10 batch instructions ([b]lb[/b], [b]sb[/b], [b]sbn[/b]) still find it by its usual prefab hash.
[b]This is a Plugin Mod.[/b] It needs BepInEx with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gruffuss/badges/main/ai-assisted.png[/img]
[hr][/hr] [h2]⚠️ Back up your save first[/h2] [b]This mod writes extra data into your save[/b]: a marker on every structure you mirror. The game still loads such a save without the mod (mirrored structures simply come back unmirrored), but any mod that touches saves carries some risk. [b]A backup costs nothing. A lost base costs a lot.[/b]
[hr][/hr] [h2]🔧 How to use[/h2] [list] [*][b]Press M[/b] while holding a kit. While mirroring is on, the placement panel says [b]Mirrored. Press M to undo.[/b] [*][b]Place as usual.[/b] Rotation works exactly as for the normal structure. [*][b]One build per press.[/b] M switches off after you place, when you put the kit away, or when you take another kit. Letting go before the build finishes keeps it on. [/list]
[h2]🚫 Not mirrorable[/h2] [table] [tr][th]Structure[/th][th]Why[/th][/tr] [tr][td]Pipes and cables[/td][td]A mirrored pipe or cable piece is just another rotation[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Consoles and logic displays[/td][td]Their screens decide orientation from the structure's own axes[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Walls, window shutters, seats, launch mounts[/td][td]Their code depends on left and right[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Rocket hulls[/td][td]Not supported[/td][/tr] [/table] Pressing M on one of these shows the reason in the game console.
[h2]⚙️ Settings[/h2] In the StationeersLaunchPad mod settings: [list] [*][b]Controls / ToggleMirror[/b]: the mirror key (default [b]M[/b]). [*][b]Controls / OneBuildPerPress[/b] (default on): turn off to keep M on until you press it again. [*][b]Controls / KeepControlsVanilla[/b] (default on): turn off to mirror switches, buttons, knobs, dials and wheels along with the structure. Only changes how your own game shows them. [*][b]Diagnostics / Debug[/b] (default off): detailed logging for bug reports. [/list]
[h2]🌐 Multiplayer[/h2] [b]Multiplayer has not been tested yet.[/b] Every player needs the mod, in the same version. A player without it, or with another version, is refused at join with the mismatch listed, instead of joining into a broken game.
[h2]🧩 Known limits[/h2] [list] [*]Lettering painted onto a structure's model, like "FILL TANK" on the gas tank storage, reads backwards on a mirrored copy. Screens and text drawn by the game stay readable. [*]Cloning a rocket loses the mirror on the devices inside it. [*]A control nested deep inside another moving part may stay mirrored; with Debug on, the log names it. [/list]
[hr][/hr] [h2]📋 Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [*][url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [/list]
